findings.title: Remote checker-pin test does not guard route dispatch
findings.detail: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/mod.rs:811 tests reject_unsupported_checker_pin directly rather than exercising run_transfer_inner or run_move_inner. I disabled both production calls at lines 305 and 544 and the intended test remained green, so the claimed guarantee that every remote route refuses the diagnostic pin can regress unnoticed. Test through the dispatch or CLI boundary.

findings.title: Unsupported checker pins are rejected after user-visible startup actions
findings.detail: The new checks at crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/mod.rs:305 and :544 run only after the starting banner and, for mirror/move, after destructive confirmation. An invalid remote copy therefore prints "starting" before failing, while mirror/move can prompt for an operation that cannot run. Perform route-dependent validation immediately after route resolution, before warnings, banners, or prompts.
